description: What the Axon window is allowed to ask this process to do.

permissions.comment: Any host and any port, because the server is the user's own and is chosen at runtime (ADR 0102 § 3) — there is no build-time host to narrow this to. Note ':*' is load-bearing: 'http://*' alone means port 80, so a LAN axon on :8080 is denied.
Ask the user where to put a downloaded attachment. The dialog is the only thing that chooses a path; nothing here can pick one on the user's behalf.

Write the bytes to the path the save dialog returned. Unscoped by design: the user names the destination, and pre-declaring a directory would either forbid the one they pick or grant more than the dialog did.
Hand an http(s) link to the user's browser. `isExternalHref` in app.tsx admits only http and https, so this cannot be used to launch a local program.
